calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS sales, 0 AS refunds, p.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, 0, r.refund_net, p.category
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(sales) sales_before_returns, SUM(refunds) refunds, SUM(sales)-SUM(refunds) net_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN sales-refunds ELSE 0 END) test_part, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) d, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ds FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900)

SELECT (rs.store_id=900) return_at_web, (ss.store_id=900) sale_is_web, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_net) refund
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net_by_order_date
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_net),2) web_refunds_booked_in_stores
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key AND rs.store_id<>900
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key AND ss.store_id=900
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) ctrl_net, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns),2) ctrl_before, ROUND(SUM(r.returns_net),2) ctrl_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
